gloss: back to back; inseparably linked (with danger or risk)

definitions.gloss: back to back; standing with backs touching
definitions.explanation: The physical position of two people standing or sitting with their backs against each other.

definitions.gloss: inseparably linked; two sides of the same coin
definitions.explanation: Figuratively describes two things that are closely connected, especially when something positive is inseparably linked with something negative or risky.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}は{背中合|せなかあ}わせに{座|すわ}った。
examples.english: The two sat back to back.

examples.japanese: {背中合|せなかあ}わせに{立|た}って{身長|しんちょう}を{比|くら}べた。
examples.english: We stood back to back to compare our heights.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちは{背中合|せなかあ}わせになって、お{互|たが}いを{押|お}し{合|あ}う{遊|あそ}びをしていた。
examples.english: The children stood back to back and played a game of pushing against each other.

examples.japanese: {成功|せいこう}と{失敗|しっぱい}は{背中合|せなかあ}わせだ。
examples.english: Success and failure are two sides of the same coin.

examples.japanese: {幸福|こうふく}と{不幸|ふこう}は{背中合|せなかあ}わせだと{言|い}われる。
examples.english: It is said that happiness and unhappiness are inseparably linked.

examples.japanese: {便利|べんり}さと{危険|きけん}は{背中合|せなかあ}わせで、テクノロジーには{常|つね}にリスクが{伴|ともな}う。
examples.english: Convenience and danger go hand in hand — technology always carries risk.

notes:
Literally "backs together" — from {背中|せなか} (back) + {合|あ}わせ (together). The literal sense describes the physical position, while the figurative sense expresses the idea that two contrasting things are inseparably connected, like two sides of the same coin.

USAGE:
As a physical description (sense 1), it is used with に as an adverb: {背中合|せなかあ}わせに{立|た}つ. In the figurative sense (sense 2), it typically functions as a predicate: AとBは{背中合|せなかあ}わせだ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背中合|せなかあ}わせに{立|た}つ — to stand back to back
- {背中合|せなかあ}わせに{座|すわ}る — to sit back to back
- {背中合|せなかあ}わせの{関係|かんけい} — an inseparable relationship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {表裏一体|ひょうりいったい} — two sides of one body; more formal, same figurative meaning
- {紙一重|かみひとえ} — paper-thin difference; emphasizes how close two outcomes are
